transcript.text:
Thank you all for sharing that information — it's exactly what I need to make good decisions. Let me summarize what I've heard so I can finalize the plan:

1. Jordan: The food pantry can receive exactly 24 kg of our harvest, labeled for pickup. I'll factor that into the harvest distribution.
2. Leah: You can only garden from 10:00 AM onward due to your migraine medication. I'll make sure any care tasks assigned to you start at 10:00 or later.
3. Ravi: Bed 3 already has the acidic soil prep for blueberries, per horticulturist Nina Patel's recommendation — acidic mix, no lime. I'll designate Bed 3 for blueberries accordingly.
4. Tessa: You'll care for Bed 2 every Tuesday and Thursday from 18:00 to 19:00 throughout June 2026. I'll write that into the care plan.

With a 40 kg expected harvest, allocating 24 kg to the pantry leaves 16 kg for the family. Unless anyone has anything else to add, I'm ready to settle the plan with these decisions incorporated.
